mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_task_entry_access(application_id, entry_id, enabled, policy_json, creator, updater) VALUES (#{app}, #{entry}, #{enabled}, CAST(#{json} AS jsonb), #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT(application_id, entry_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, policy_json = EXCLUDED.policy_json, lock_version = nocode_task_entry_access.lock_version + 1, updater = #{actor}, update_time = clock_timestamp()
